note: Germination/emergence edges are driven by water addition/availability (watering), not water table or water level; e1 water level -> moss fragment regeneration is not seed germination; e56 'emergent vegetation' area is not seedling emergence.
No candidate links wildfire/fire history to NEE, ER, GEP or CO2 flux; fire edges concern soil nutrients, CO2 edges are driven by PAR, moisture or time since harvest.
Only logging edges (e12, e23) concern low-flow streamflow yield, not erosion or sediment loss.
Shoot/root ratio and mycorrhizal short-root edges excluded as not productivity; e14 root-collar diameter counted as a growth measure. Study X09-115 is internally tied.

Only e61 (tilling disturbance -> introduced perennial grass cover) fits; tilling read as soil site preparation, a judgement call. Cover-soil type contrasts (LFH vs peat, FMM vs PMM, direct vs stockpiled) are variant-vs-variant and not site preparation.
Only e16 (boulder clusters -> macroinvertebrate community convergence on PC1) fits; ordination-based outcome, effect null. Woody-debris piles in clearcuts are terrestrial, not instream.

Excluded variant contrasts (exponential vs conventional e2/e6/e57/e10/e28/e32, Forest vs Silva Paks e18), combined release+liming (e35/e49), e68 (sentence does not show IAF beat unfertilized), nutrient/N-concentration, cover and abundance outcomes, salmonid biomass. 5 of 9 studies increase.
Diversity-index edges (Simpson dominance e31/e35/e52) are driven by winter road clearances, which are not trampling or recreation; no recreation candidates found.

No time-since-disturbance edge reaches temperature/microclimate: e6 canopy openness and e32 active-layer depth are not microclimate; e50 is a long-term climate trend since 1938, not time since disturbance.

Only fit is time since lake recovery from acidification -> zooplankton survival in low-pH assays (one study); read as time since disturbance, borderline. Elk time-since-release, calendar-year nest survival and juvenile recruitment edges excluded.
